notes.title: Coreborn Full-Release with Liquid Meadows Expansion
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Coreborn,

We at Blankhans are thrilled to announce that we have just launched Coreborn into its full release along with the major Liquid Meadows update. The past few months have been an incredible experience for us, largely thanks to all of you, our community. Together, we've implemented numerous changes, and you've been an integral part of this journey. The game has evolved significantly, and we believe it's for the better.

You can now construct new bases on public or private servers, explore new shores, ride mounts to distant lands, and engage with a wealth of new and redesigned content. We're eager to hear your feedback and see how you enjoy the game. Share your thoughts with us, gather your friends, and immerse yourselves in Coreborn together.

Thank you all, and a special thanks to everyone at Blankhans for their dedication, passion and kindness. Today is a wonderful day to celebrate this journey and the adventures that lie ahead!

Also, as a reminder: 30% off! Tell your friends! And please make sure to leave behind a review to reflect your experience so we can share, celebrate, and/or facilitate improvement! 

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes: May 16, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! The global wipe is completed and brings about a few important changes including a highly-requested player feature: personal servers and MORE! Read below for the full details on how you can take advantage of this and other features.

Also, a reminder that there will be one more wipe in a couple of weeks as part of our massive launch of Liquid Meadows and the Children of the Source. As we are still in Early Access, this will be a crucial time period to refine and make necessary changes ahead of a launch.

[h2]SALE[/h2]
From now until May 30th, save 70% on the price of Coreborn! If you haven’t had a chance to check out our previous patches or are curious about our new ones, this is the perfect opportunity to do so!

[h2]Single Player[/h2]
You now have the option to start the game in Single Player mode at the main menu screen. While in Single Player, you can access the Server Settings at the main menu, but be aware that some of the changes you do here might need you to restart the Single Player.

Also, it is possible to get a backup of your old map to experiment with and [b]use it on the Single Player mode or apply it on the Server[/b]. 
[list]
[*]For Single Player, go to the path [i]Coreborn\DedicatedServer\Ultracore\Saved\SaveGames[/i]. This is also where you can "Wipe" your Single Player experience
[*] If you want to have a Backup of your old Server please reach out to us here: [url=https://blankhans.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portals]https://blankhans.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portals[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Server Browser[/h2]
If you press Play Online, you will now see the Server Browser. Here, you can spot Official Servers (they’ll have a blue Coreborn Logo) or join servers that other players have rented. 

[h2]Rented Servers[/h2]
Players now have the option to rent their own server here: [url=https://pockethost.app/en/gameserver/coreborn-server-hosting/]https://pockethost.app/en/gameserver/coreborn-server-hosting/ [/url]. By default, your server will not show up in the Server Browser. So, if you want to see it there, be sure to make it public in the Server Settings. You can also set a password for the server and add an admin password to access the Sever Settings. Also, be aware some changes require a server restart.

[h2]Swimming[/h2]
You wanted it; you got it. Players can now SWIM! Swimming is limited by your stamina on the stamina wheel. The only way to recover stamina is by leaving the water. If you run out of stamina while in the water, you will start to take damage and eventually die. This swimming addition also comes with some changes to waterways in Ambros. :]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you can't do certain actions, a Jibbling will show up
[*] Added some Steam Achievements! Let's see if you can achieve all of them
[*] Added a Barber in Pipers Whistle that lets you change your appearance without deleting your character(!!!!)
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now all consumables should be affected by consumable hoarder perk
[*] [i]Prodigal Alchemist[/i] Perk should now apply to all potions
[/list]
[h3]Things that have been removed/temporarily disabled:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Coreheim was removed
[*] The [i]Capture the Crown[/i] mini game was removed (The ‘Fancy’ Armor Set might come back in the future)
[*] Server Travel and friends list have been disabled
[/list]
Thank you to everyone for your patience throughout all of this. We look forward to the continued growth of your towns. Please remain aware that the second-and-likely-last wipe will take place in a couple of weeks right before the long-awaited launch of Liquid Meadows (new area) and the Children of the Source (new race/weapon)!! Please make sure to contact us or visit us on our [url=https://discord.gg/blankhans]Discord[/url]!

- [i]Your Blankhans Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-12-02
notes.notes:
[h3]PATCH NOTES: February 12, 2024[/h3]

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated in-game Localization 
[/list]

[h2]Combat & Animation Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where if a creature died during an animation, the animation would still play in its entirety
[*] Fixed a bug where no footstep sound would play in lock-on mode while strafing
[*] Improved visual overlay effect for iframes during dodge and when receiving damage; it’s now applied to the entire character.
[/list]

[h2]Town Building Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the general workbench didn't count towards upgrade requirements.
[*] Fixed an issue with pinned recipes, specifically with the cost reduction perk on certain crafting recipes.
[*] Fixed an issue with Building Pieces that displayed an incorrect, alternative version of the selected piece while moving the piece around 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused scaled Building Pieces to change their scaling after being moved
[*] Fixed certain areas where Creatures could spawn or walk into cliffs near Lovers Shire
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented claiming abandoned towns that didn't have a gate
[/list]

[h2]Town Attacks Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented new possible Town Attack Outcome - “Draw”, which will be triggered, when
[*] Enemies are not defeated within the Town Attack time limit
[*] No valid path can be found from a gate to the Town Center
[*] The attacking Enemies can’t find a valid spawn location
[*] A draw lets the current Wrath goes down by 10, so if you deposit another Crystal an attack will start
[*] Losing a town attack does not cause a deleveling, it will reduce the crystals you put into the town by by 50% and reset the wrath to 0 
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have made 'leveling up' the town a bespoke interaction. This button does not automatically appear in the town menu when you meet the requirements, you will have to close and reopen the town menu.
[*] Darkwood Beams use a smaller variant as default, these don't connect to the ground. You can switch to the large one by Shift+Scrolling
[*] The combat finishers we removed still have an entry in the Keybinds, this key is shared with 'Copy Blueprint'. You can ignore the duplicating keybind warning when you assign a new key to copy blueprint.
[/list]

As always, we appreciate your feedback, and if you have something to say, let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/https://discord.gg/blankhans]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Gamescom Patch: Localization, Quality Vendors and the first Adventure
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes [#6] 22.08.2023[/h1]

Greetings, dearest adventurers of Coreborn!

Another fantastic day with Gamescom ahead and an update for you to enjoy! Our latest efforts have resulted in several changes brimming with enhancements and fixes we are excited to share with you. Without further ado, let's delve into the heart of the changes that await you: 

[h2]General:[/h2]

- We added our first official Adventure, called "Capture the Crown"! You can access it via the Adventure Finder by using either the social menu (P), the menu of your town, or the Adventure NPC in Coreheim.
- We also added the reward vendor near the Adventure NPC in Coreheim. With this NPC, you can spend the hard-earned Jib Coins you won in the Adventures and exchange them for fabulous prizes. 
- With that we also moved the crystal exchange vendor a little bit to the side and improved it with the new vendor UI
- We finally added the framework for translations, covering the following languages at this point: 
• German
• Czech
• Spanish
• French
• Italian
• Japanese
• Polish
• Portuguese
• Russian
• Turkish
• Chinese
(Please keep in mind that these are still work in progress, so if you encounter any issues, translation errors, and such, don't hesitate to create a ticket and let us know)
- We also added a new NPC type: Quality Vendors. 
•You may trade items of lower quality with these guys for more qualitative items of the same type. You can find them in Coreheim and Ambros, marked with one to three stars above their heads, indicating the level of the items you can get (3 stars being the highest quality items). They are also marked on the map with the same symbols. 
- We added an F1 Help page to explain the Quality Vendors and the Adventure to you in more detail.
- We reworked the tutorial to make it less time-consuming and no longer leave you with a cluttered inventory.



[h2]Game Design:[/h2]

- You now gain XP when building furniture items and other building pieces.
- Traveling to Coreheim no longer has a Cooldown and will put you back right where you pressed the Travel button once you return to the Survivalmap.
- Therefore we also added an "Unstuck" Button that will send you back to a valid spot on the map 
- We tuned the town crystal requirements on the lower town levels so it's easier for players to reach the early levels of town progression.
- The antidote was temporarily removed. Since we currently don't have anything capable of poisoning you, at this point in time, it feels unrewarding as loot.
- We slightly increased the drop rate of Golden Garnet.
- We added Tanta Flint to the Gold drop loot table and Ambrosian Opal to the Iron Ore loot table.
- The Ambrosian Opal requirement on the Tier 1 Anvil was removed, and we adjusted the Dornwood requirement for this station from 10 to 6.
- The Golden Garnet requirement on the Tier 2 Anvil was removed, and we adjusted the Ellyonwood requirement for this station from 15 to 12.
- The Tanta Flint requirement on the Tier 4 Geocasting wheel was removed, and we adjusted the Gold Ingot requirement for this station from 5 to 4.
- We reduced the heartwood cost of the stone axe from 5 to 2.
- We reduced the heartwood cost of the stone pickaxe from 5 to 4.


[h2]Engineering:[/h2]

- We improved the overall performance when mass crafting.
- Fixed the stack size on the clay molds.

[h2]UI / UX:[/h2]

- Fixed a bug that caused the recipe icons to flicker while crafting.
- Fixed a bug that caused the category symbols to vanish after using the take-all button.
- Added a visual indicator to the map icon of your town center, showing you directly when an attack is happening.
- We changed the UI a little to fit specific texts better. They will now automatically scroll if they exceed the textbox.

[h2]3D, Level Design, and Animations:[/h2]

- Some building pieces were missing the hit effect, so we fixed that, and you now get proper feedback.
- Our diligent Level Designer patched more holes, crevices, and nudges you could get stuck in. 
- We had some voice NPCs that were accidentally placed outside the gates of Coreheim.
- We improved the pathfinding of the AI on some bridges


These changes are a testament to your dedication and feedback. We remain committed to crafting an experience that resonates with your wishes, needs, and ideas. As you embark on new adventures, remember that your input is what makes changes happen!

Thank you once again for standing beside us on this extraordinary journey.

Forge on, Coreborn!

Your Blankhans Team

You can also find the information regarding this patch in video form here

[previewyoutube=an6II1MKlis;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2023-08-09
notes.notes:
Patch Notes [#5]

We hope you are having a wonderful day, dearest Coreborn!
We have returned with, of course, a fresh bunch of fixes and improvements to you to test and enjoy! But see for yourself: 

Game Design:
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue with the cost reduction perk on crafting stations.
[*] Crafting stations now use the items from the player inventory plus all available chests in a town. 
[*] (To Enable a Storage Chest for Town Crafting, click the Lock in the top right corner of the Storage Chest. Green ( Open Lock) means all stations in the town can use this storage chest to get items. Red ( Closed Lock ) means the crafting stations don't take resources out of this chest.)
[/list]

Engineering:
[list]
[*] We added a place and a destroy VFX to the anvil and the cooking stations.
[*] Fixed an issue of losing stability when you mixed different building materials.
[*] We implemented an additional town ID check to fix some issues when accessing storage chests.
[*] We Fixed a Bug that was caused by the cost reduction perk on certain crafting stations.
[/list]

UI / UX:
[list]
[*] Fixed the credits overlapping with the version number.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could see all towns on the map.
[*] The new map markers now have outlines for better visibility.
[*] Added a “fighting” symbol to the town, when it is under attack.
[/list]

3D, Level Design, and Animations:
[list]
[*] We’ve removed collision from some foragable resources (Berry Bushes, Serenade Anchora, … ) 
[*] Added ambience sounds (pipes, steam, etc.) to Coreheim.
[*] Removed some Voice NPCs from Coreheim.
[*] The Resin VFX of the Oropala no longer collides with its tail. 
[*] We have improved the AI pathfinding on roads.
[*] We also updated the Oropala Resin attack animation to no longer skip the recovery.
[*] The player slash attack VFX should no longer cause the strange rotation offset.
[/list]

As always: Thank you so much for your feedback. We are adding more and more quality-of-life features while also trying to address the bugs and issues you are reporting, so please keep those requests, ideas, and problem reports coming so that we can keep improving the game for all of you!

Your Blankhans Team
[hr][/hr]
[i]Addendum: We are aware of the current bug that causes a crash/lag when crafting mass items at a crashing station and are working on a solution. Thank you![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2023-08-01
notes.notes:
Happy Tuesday to all in the Corenations!

We are pleased to present to you our Patch #4, the result of your valuable feedback and further improvement by our fantastic team, to address your ideas, bug reports, and requests.
But as always, let's cut to the chase and get to what really is important. The changes!

General:

[list]
[*] User-specific Keybinding is finally a thing now!
[*] You can now remove Town Expansions you've already placed.Keep in mind you can only destroy the furthest expansion from your town center. Also if a creature destroys a town extension all extensions beyond that distance will be destroyed as well.
[*] The Oropala Armor Set got added to the creature-specific mystery bags.
[*] We added a credits button to the main menu so you can see who worked on the game!
[/list]

Game Design:
[list]
[*] The quality of a mystery bag is now determined by the lowest quality item in its loot table.
[*] We slightly increased the drop rate of Golden Garnet.
[/list]

UI / UX:
[list]
[*] Names of your town members are now shown, even when they are offline
[/list]

3D, Level Design, and Animations:
[list]
[*] More resources that previously spawned too high up or outside the shield were placed back on the ground and within the shield. 
[*] We added some Griz to certain caves.
[*] The outskirts of Coreheim got a little polish.
[*] But also, Coreheim itself got polished, so check it out!
[*] Mud that before spawned on Iron Ore Spawns got removed.
[/list]

Thanks again, and we sincerely hope you enjoy the new and further polished content. We look forward to hearing more of your thoughts and feedback, so remember to let us know what's happening in your head!

Until next time,

The Blankhans Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 2023-07-26
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes: 2023-26-07[/h1]

Greetings, our dearest Coreborn!

We happily announce our next patch, packed with new content, optimizations, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience like never before. All your feedback has been instrumental in shaping this update, and we cannot wait for you to dive in!

But let's cut things short; Here's our list of all the additions, changes, and fixes: 

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] We added an extra row of slots to your inventory.
[*] Veerking and the Wartorn Teraiva got a boost to their stats.
[*] We buffed the town gate health up a lot to combat the fast decay until we can properly fix this issue.
[/list]
[b]Game Design:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash animations are faster and no longer block input briefly after dashing, letting you attack instantly after or just before the dash ends.
[*] We have reduced the town attack and wave timers to 10 seconds.
[*] The Veerking can now be accompanied by up to 4 Feydveer fawns instead of 2.
[*] We turned off collision on the ice VFX for the Icypala ranged attack.
[*] The schematic for the uncommon Feydveer leg armor is now included in the elite Feydveer mystery loot bag.
[/list]
[b]Engineering & Backend:[/b]
[list]
[*] We fixed that you can't lose XP on some skills to gain XP on others. 
[*] Fixed an issue where some items were highlighted as craftable even though you couldn't craft them.
[*] Fixed that when players log out, their tools & weapons sometimes float in the air.
[*] You no longer have to walk forth and back to the workbenches to use them multiple times.
[/list]
[b]UI / UX:[/b]
[list]
[*] Included visible rotation to the Player Marker on the map in preparation for future quality of life improvement patch.
[*] The crystals exchange rate info on the F1 help menu got updated.
[*] Infos on the Wartorn Teraiva and the Veerking were added to the F1 menu.
[/list]
[b]3D, Level Design, and Animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] You discovered a few holes on the map that we patched up
[*] Additionally a sulfur spawner snuck outside of the shield and got safely put back inside. 
[*] Another one floated in the air and was put back on the ground. 
[*] The outskirts of Coreheim got a little polish.
[*] Fixed a problem where creatures couldn't crossroads
[/list]
Thanks to all of you for being an important part of the Coreborn community. Your support continues to inspire us. As always, your feedback is invaluable, so please keep sharing your thoughts, ideas, and criticism with us and help make this experience the best it can be.

We'll see you in-game!

Your Blankhans Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 2023-07-21
notes.notes:
A wonderful third day after Early Access Launch, Coreborn!

We are back with more fixes, tunes, and changes for our second patch. 
Your valuable feedback following the first patch has been instrumental in shaping this update, and we're committed to improving your gaming experience even further. Additionally, we addressed some issues raised previously that we couldn't implement in the first update.
Thank you for your continued support and dedication; your passion fuels our drive to create the best gaming experience possible!

The adjustments address various issues, enhance gameplay mechanics, and refine the overall user experience. But less talk, more details. Here is our list of today's fixes: 

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] After receiving the most requests for this feature in the last poll, you can now hold down the left-click to use your tools!
[*] Watch out for the stronger Feydveer's big brother, who's now roaming Ambros! May we introduce: The Veerking!
[*] The Teraivas also got a bit of special reinforcement: Introducing the strongerWar-torn Teraiva!
[*] A new feature arrived! We included the first interior items for your towns!
We are currently still actively further developing this feature, so please be aware of the following: 

* If your crates break, the content will be lost. So stow them away safely and protect them during town attacks!
* Currently, you cannot place items on the crates, but we are actively working on making that possible.
* Interior Items are susceptible to damage (also by Town Attacks), but repair is available for free (health increased by 50% per hit with your hammer) 
* Interior Items can be unlocked through specific Skills and will be displayed accordingly.
* Some items have a "Shift + Mousewheel" function to give you additional styles for an object. 
[/list]

[b]Game Design[/b]

[list]
[*] Some "Boost" Skills didn't apply the stat boni correctly, so that got fixed. 
[*] Additionally, we took care of the defense boost perk being broken. 
[*] We rebalanced the combat stats a bit, so let us know how you feel!
[*] The effectiveness of the chill resistance elixir is now increased by 100% 
[*] Repairing your structures now gives them 50% of their health back, instead of 10%
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial step in which you need to join a town didn't count if you already were a member of a town.
[*] We changed the contents of a lot of mystery loot bags
[*] We lowered town attack preparation timer to 2 minutes
[*] A quick fix got applied, so that out of reach creatures in town attacks no longer cause them to fail but be successful after the timer runs out and we lowered the fallback timer to 30 minutes
[*] We fixed some recipe tuning where ingredients required higher level stations that were still blocked by the town progression
[*] The maximum number of players receiving loot from NPCs increased to 5.
[*] Grouping behavior to Feydveer, Forsveer, Mosdir, Haydir and Aisdir got reintroduced.
[/list]

[b]Engineering & Backend[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with gravestones spawning in places where you couldn't reach them
[*] We have fixed an issue where objects could be repaired immediately after building them because they lost health due to deterioration.
[/list]

[b]UI / UX[/b]

[list]
[*] We have revised some of the content for the F1 help menu.
[*] A few recipe descriptions were updated since they gave outdated information.
[*] We replaced the placeholder description texts for all Greatswords.
[*] Some of you had trouble changing the resolution in Borderless Mode. That's fixed now.
[/list]

[b]3D, Level Design, and Animations[/b]

[list]
[*] Iron Boulders and the Iron Ore Spawns got minor adjustments in their placement and color.
[*] The forest by the graveyard got a little extra set dressing and polishing
[*] Fixed some clipping of chopping animation when  the hedonist was wearing the cloth armor
[*] An animation bug for the Icypala got removed. 
[*] Most resources no longer should be flying around in the air and iron ore should also be back on the ground where it belongs.
[*] Improved combat animations for enhanced agility
[*] Some adjustments to the map were made (Smoothing out some transitions, changing some hills to farmlands) 
[*] The small trees in the farmland are now displaying the correct name.
[/list]

We're excited to hear from you how you feel about this patch and believe it'll make your gaming experience even better. If you come across any issues or have any thoughts to share, don't hesitate to let us know. Your input is what drives us to create a game hopefully all of you will enjoy. 

Our Dev team is here to assist you whenever you need it, so feel free to reach out anytime!

Thanks again for all your feedback, love, and valuable opinions. We can't wait to have you with us for the next patch!

Your Blankhans Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 2023-07-19
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes: 2023-19-07[/h1]

Greetings, Coreborn!

We're excited to bring you the first patch of our Early Access! We tried to address various issues you reported to us and improve your gaming experience. Thank you for your feedback and support, it’s greatly appreciated and helps us foster a better Coreborn for everyone!

Without further ado, let's dive into the details of this patch. Below, you'll find a list of the changes made, ordered by their level of significance within their category:

[h2]General: [/h2]
[list]
[*]We added two new buttons to the Game Settings menu, including a Survey Button and a Contact Support Button. We also fixed that little spelling mistake on the “T(r)avel to Coreheim” Button. 
[*]You now can destroy level 1 Town Center and build closer to your Town Center. 
[*]Some adjustments to the Volume were made. 
[/list]
[h2]Game Design: [/h2]
[list]
[*]Sprinting no longer costs Stamina and the “Seasoned Runner” Perk now gives you 20% more speed when sprinting. 
[*]We fixed the issue with Town Gates and Crafting Stations being unbuildable when your inventory was full. 
[*]All creatures got rebalanced, making them weaker and easier to read in combat. 
[*]A yellow impact VFX and SFX were added to give you visual feedback when you land a critical hit on a creature
[*]You will no longer gain greatsword charges from hitting the environment (Stones, Trees, etc.), only from actual enemies. 
[*]The Survival Plank and the Survival Campfire no longer use the Lightwood Set’s repair cost, but have their own repair cost now. Additionally the Survival Campfire now visually shows when it gets damaged. 
[*]Wooden Incense can now be crafted at the Woodworking Bench. Stone Blocks are now moved to Advanced Geocasting Level 0. We also fixed some typos in the recipe descriptions. 
[*]We’ve added the “Entangled” status effect for when you get caught up in vines or mud, for improved visual feedback.
[*]The first town expansion is now available at Town Level 3.
[*]Some delay was applied to the Feydveers ranged attack and the SFX & VFX is now fixed. 
[*]Vine obstacles and log pile obstacles will now say “Thorny Vines” and “Logs” when targeted. When Thorny Vines deal damage, you will now receive visual feedback.
[*]Jumping, while having the greatsword equipped, looks and feels better now. 
[/list]
[h2]Engineering & Backend: [/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now find a slider in the settings, which lets you adjust your camera sensitivity. 
[*]A bug that could lead to being stuck in an attack animation got removed. 
[*]The camera collision with falling logs got disabled.
[*]A new Matchmaking system for Coreheim was implemented. 
[*]We fixed the bug of aprons sometimes vanishing after login back into the game. 
[*]We changed the notification message on the town gate placement when the gate isn't being placed on the town border.
[/list]
[h2]UI / UX: [/h2]
[list]
[*]We added the [Press Q] prompt for when a combo charge is available. 
[*]Fixed the issue of “Traveling to Coreheim” blocking the menus.
[/list]
[h2]3D, Level Design and Animations [/h2]
[list]
[*]New bridges were added to the Frozen Peaks.
[*]Many cliffs that previously were no-build-zones are now possible to build on. 
[*]Fixed some clipping on Nib the Jib, as well as some minor weight painting issues. 
[*]The density and placement of the creatures in the Moss Seas and Mountains got adjusted.
[*]New fonts were added to the road signs in Ambros.
[*]Modified the "Ambrosian Pants" to avoid clipping by the skirt.
[/list]
We hope this patch provides a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience for all of you. Your feedback plays a vital role in our ongoing efforts to enhance the game, so please continue to share your thoughts and report any issues you encounter so we can keep on addressing them. 

If you have any questions or need assistance, our Dev team is always here to help. Don't hesitate to reach out to us!

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope to see you for the next patch!


The Blankhans Team

notes.title: Coreborn Open Beta Patch Updates 23.06.2023
notes.notes:
New Update incoming!

Hello dearest Coreborn,
exciting news! We are back with a new patch note announcement! We heard your feedback and read your reports and did our best to fix the things bugging (insert Badum-Tss) you currently and adjusting the tuning a bit to see how it feels.

We … 

[b]UI: [/b]

[list]
[*] added a function enabling you to transfer items in inventories via right-click.
[*] added an error message to the building UI for when you don’t have enough resources to build a structure. 
[*] enabled closing the menus (i.e. chests) with “E”.
[*] added an error message to the Weapon Assembly Station when you have no space in your inventory to disassemble all of the pieces. 
[*] added some UI changes to the Skill Menu.
[/list]

[b]Level Design:[/b]

[list]
[*] added some new hidden or blocked paths to the Southern Mountains of Ambros for you to explore.
[*] adjusted the resource distribution of clay and sulfur.
[*] adjusted the creature distribution in certain places so that they now guard choke points or resources. 
[*] fixed the landscape spline overlapping
[*] patched even more holes in the ground.
[/list]

[b]Creatures:[/b]

[list]
[*] added a fix that prevents lootable creatures from blocking damage and building structures
[*] added a new VFX to the Mosdir, Haydir and Aisdir groundslam attack.
[*] decreased the movement speed of Forsveer, making it easier for you to hunt them down.
[*] fixed a bug that caused the VFX not being displayed correctly, when creatures get hit.
[*] added a VFX to the Gothkin spawn animation. 
[*] added a new VFX to the Jibbling animation..
[*] added brand new idles to the Juristographs in Coreheim and Piper’s Whistle
[/list]

[b]Towns:[/b]

[list]
[*] doubled the base wrath for building Building Pieces and doubled the wrath gained by leveling up your town.
[*] fixed the issue of players being able to place infinite town extensions (Sorry guys!)
[*] added an extra wave to the Town Attack Levels 1 to 11. 
[/list]

[b]Tuning: [/b]

[list]
[*] increased the hits it takes to mine coal from 2 to 3.
[*] reduced the XP gained from finishing PBS pieces. 
[*] increased the drop rates for Quartz and Ambrosian Opal with the extra mining perk
[*] increased the damage dealt by the freezing status effect significantly.
[/list]

[b]Additional Fixes: [/b]

[list]
[*] fixed a bug causing you to show up twice in a session after a time-out.
[*] fixed a bug causing the gravestone to despawn too quickly.
[*] fixed the bug causing players to sometimes be invincible to damage.
[*] added two new armor recipes being unlocked in the Smelting 1 Skill of your Skill Menu, which give you that Chill Resistence you need to make your way through the mountains without freezing your neckplates off [*]
[*] improved the pivot points and the collision for the stone roof.
[*] fixed the problem of players sometimes losing their progress under certain circumstances
[/list]


Please remember that we value your feedback immensely. Your thoughts and suggestions help us shape the future of Coreborn and we are doing our best to build something that you guys enjoy just as much as we do.. Feel free to share your experiences with us as we continue to refine and evolve. 

Keep the opinions and reports coming! 

The Blankhans Team

notes.title: Coreborn Open Beta Patch Notes 21.06.2023
notes.notes:
Hey Coreborn!

We have some news for you concerning our latest update, that will be implemented within the next hour. Once you receive the message from the server, please be aware that it will take about 5 minutes for the server to fully shut down. After that, please log out of the game entirely and download the update from Steam, which by that time will be available for you.

We greatly value your feedback, as it plays an important role in shaping our game. Please continue sharing your thoughts with us so that we can work together to refine and expand the Open Beta experience.

[list]
[*] Here's a quick rundown of the changes we’ve made:
[*] A fix will now prevent players from connecting to servers with a mismatching client version.
[*] Creature health points will now reset after a certain time when no longer under attack.
[*] We’ve applied further fixes to the “server maintenance” notification to communicate it clearer.
[*] We have fixed an issue with the bug report functionality that didn’t work as intended.
[*] We’ve also fixed the bug of sounds that weren't played correctly, when crafting something successfully.
[*] An issue of the unlocking of skills not giving the right information in the notification was fixed.
[*] We have increased the amount of sulfur spawners in the southern and northern mountains
[*] Some item descriptions got updated.
[*] Also, the F1 help page got an update for more context and some small corrections.
[*] We fixed a bug where the Town markers were incorrectly displayed on the map after traveling to another Ambros server.
[*] We increased the movement speed of creatures to be faster than the default player movement speed.
[*] The tuning for Shrivel Wood Root got adjusted.
[*] All consumable items now can be pulled into the quickslots.
[*] The Molians got some animation fixes and were added to Piper’s Whistle and Coreheim
[*] We fixed a bug that blocked scrolling in chat.
[*] Some minor UI bugs (i.e. weapon assembly, inventory, notifications, town attacks) got fixed.
[*] We reduced the amount of ingredients needed for the first 3 healing bandages.
[*] We have fixed the bug that caused players to be able to destroy gatherables with weapons.
[*] The tuning of the healing consumables got adjusted.
[*] We patched some more holes in the ground.
[*] We fixed an issue with the replication of red chests that could lead to crashes.
[*] A bug was fixed, that ensures that Gothkin no longer can destroy chests in Town Attacks
[*] We added mirrored stairs for the PBS sets.
[*] The PBS Stone Roof pivot got an improvement and the PBS Stone half wall got removed.
[*] The Audio NPCs got a little rework to look better and more authentic.
[*] We tuned our Town Level Upgrades a bit and applied a fix to the Level 1 Town Attack.
[*] And last but not least: We increased the spawn rate of coal fleur from 50% to 80%
[/list]

Please try out how the game feels to you with all the changes we made and keep giving us feedback. It's much appreciated and as you see influences what we’ll try to bring in next.

Thank you all for your ongoing support and testing,
The Blankhans Team

notes.title: Open Beta Patch Updates 20/06/2023
notes.notes:
Hey Coreborn!

We have some news for you concerning our latest update. We patched the Open Beta to bring in a few changes we would like to let you know about.

In order to implement the patch, we will restart the servers within the next half hour. You will receive a slightly buggy-looking message, which will be fixed within this patch.
Once you receive the message, please be aware that it will take about 5 minutes for the server to fully shut down. After that, please log out of the game entirely and download the update from Steam, which by that time should be available for you.

Here are the key changes brought in by this update:
[list]
[*]The Flux recipe got moved from the Expertise  Alchemy to Smelting Expertise.
[*] We’ve fixed the visuals for the server restart message, so it’s  now displaying the correct time.
[*] We have fixed errors that caused crashes, time-outs, and backend-related issues.
[*] We adjusted the audio for the market theme in Coreheim.
[*] We've patched up holes in the ground and fine-tuned resource distribution on the map.
[*]Health regeneration got increased for early food recipes.
[*]We adjusted the timings for town attack preparation:
	7-minute preparation phase, with 5 minutes for building and 2 minutes for no building.
[*] We’ve improved the drop rates for mystery bags from hunting
[*] We also decreased drop rates for mystery bags from wood & gathering
[*]The tavern in Pipers Whistle got a few visual fixes.
[*]We have added a fix for combat where players got stuck in the heavy hit animation
[*] The coloring of essence requirements in the town window got changed.
[*] Various landscape fixes have been made, including addressing holes in the ground and foliage issues.
[*] Our Molians finally got their idle animation!
[*]The F1 help menu content has been updated to provide even more specific and helpful information.
[/list]

We are confident that these changes will elevate your gaming experience and create a more polished environment for all.

Thank you for your unwavering support and valuable feedback, which has contributed to making this update possible.

Enjoy the changes and your time in the game,
The Blankhans Team
